summary: This tutorial explains how to use Thunderbird on Ubuntu 12.04 with Mailbird 1.3.01. It covers adding a Thunderbird shortcut to the launcher, tagging emails, sorting messages by various criteria like sender or subject, and filtering tagged emails. The tutorial demonstrates marking emails as important, using quick filters for tagged emails, and viewing email threads to see related messages in conversation view. It also shows how to save emails to a folder and print them. Key steps include dragging and dropping the Thunderbird icon to the launcher, clicking on the search field to type "Thunderbird," selecting the Thunderbird icon, and dragging it to the launcher. To sort messages, click on columns like From, Subject, or Received Date to sort alphabetically or reverse alphabetically. To tag emails, select the email, click the Tag icon, and choose Important or Work. Quick filters can show only tagged emails. Email threads display related messages in conversation view; clicking the thread icon shows the full conversation. Finally, saving emails to a folder named "Saved Mails" is demonstrated.
